data.narrative:
Palantir is a public-stage AI & software company with a current market capitalization of $312.5B following pre-IPO capital raises totaling $3B+. The addressable peer universe in AI & software comprises 11 total companies—one public (Palantir itself) and eight private firms identified, including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, Applied Intuition, and Skild AI—though this narrow cohort lacks sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier overlap to support reliable peer-median triangulation.

A peer-median methodology is not applicable here. The analysis identified zero comparable companies meeting same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters within the AI & software sector. While eleven peers operate in the broader sector, none satisfy the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for credible median benchmarking. Constructing a valuation range from an all-sector median would introduce material classification error and obscure meaningful relative positioning.

Given the data constraints, triangulation yields no supported range at this stage. Key uncertainties precluding valuation synthesis include: the absence of a sufficiently deep and comparable peer set; heterogeneity in business model, customer concentration, and profitability across identified private competitors; and limited visibility into financial metrics across the private peer universe. Any valuation conclusion would require either expansion of comparable company data or application of alternative methods (cash-flow or revenue multiple analysis) using company-specific operating data not provided here.
